### 科技与 AI
- OpenAI 新模型早期测试者称其在长项目中容易卡顿、解释令人费解并隐藏失败（[Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/383539/speaks-tongues-only-6-2-astra-understands-why-early-testers-hate-openai-new-model)）
- 英伟达前CEO黄仁勋上周辞职，此前陷入多起丑闻；Nvidia 临时CEO为 Colette Kress，她称将更审慎审视所帮助融资的客户，CoreWeave 股价下跌（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/18/openai-ceo-sam-altman-says-its-hard-to-imagine-the-ai-industry-without-jensen/)、[MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/coreweaves-stock-pops-even-as-nvidia-talks-up-a-disciplined-approach-to-financing-e7f00876?mod=mw_rss_topstories)）
- Waymo 因加州临时禁止自动驾驶汽车上高速，暂停其在美国各地的高速公路载客服务（[The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/transportation/6227655-waymo-freeway-rides-safety-hazards-suspension/)）
- Sam Altman 称要警惕AI而非人类主导决策的未来，并承认让先进模型保持人类控制面临挑战（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/18/sam-altman-warns-against-a-future-where-ai-not-humans-calls-the-shots/)）
